title: Report Settings: Export, Mobile, Personalization, Accessibility and Refresh

header.html: Configure export settings; Design reports for mobile devices; Enable personalization in a report, including personalized visuals; Design and configure Power BI reports for accessibility; Configure automatic page refresh
the official PL-300 study guide (skills measured as of April 20, 2026)

html:
1Export settings

Report-level export settings decide what viewers can take out of a report. In Desktop, go to File, Options, Current file, Report settings, then the Export data group.

Report setting What viewers can export
Summarized data The data shown in the visual
Summarized and underlying data Also the rows behind the visual
No export Nothing at all

Rules that exams test:

  • Admin portal settings override the report setting. If the admin restricts export, the report setting cannot loosen it.
  • Exporting underlying data needs Build permission on the semantic model.
  • Row-level security limits the exported rows to what the viewer may see.
  • Excel formats keep the sensitivity label; CSV does not.
Export type Row limit
Excel from a live connection (service) 500,000 rows
Excel (.xlsx) 150,000 rows
CSV, service or Desktop 30,000 rows
Exam tip

. Three report options: summarized only, summarized and underlying, or none. The admin portal wins over the report setting, and underlying data needs Build permission.

Exam tip

. Row limits: CSV 30,000; Excel 150,000; Excel from a live connection 500,000. Row-level security can shrink the export further.

2Mobile layout

A mobile layout is a portrait phone design for a report page. It is made in Desktop and shown only in the Power BI mobile apps.

Item Fact
Where Mobile layout on the View tab
Canvas A portrait phone canvas on a grid
Visuals The Page visuals pane lists the page's visuals; drag them onto the canvas
Auto-create Builds a first layout that you then adjust
Where it shows Only in the Power BI mobile apps, on iOS and Android
Publishing Publishing the report publishes the mobile layout too

Design each page on its own: put the key visual first and keep few visuals on the phone canvas.

Exam tip

. The mobile layout appears only in the Power BI mobile apps. It is created per page in Desktop on the View tab, and publishing the report publishes it.

3Personalization

Personalized visuals let viewers change a visual without editing the report. The author turns the setting on.

Item Fact
Setting Report settings, Personalize visuals: in Desktop under File, Options, Current file; in the service in the report Settings
Viewers can Change the visual type, swap a measure or dimension, add or remove a legend, compare measures, change the aggregation
Where In Reading view
Saving As a personal bookmark; reset returns to the author's default
Author control Turn it off for a page or a single visual
Perspectives Can limit the fields viewers see, but a perspective is not security

To restrict data, use row-level security or object-level security, never a perspective.

Exam tip

. Personalize visuals is a report setting that lets viewers change the visual type, measure, legend and aggregation, and save the result as a personal bookmark. Perspectives limit fields but are not security.

4Accessibility

Some accessibility features are built in. Others you configure.

Built in Configured by the author
Keyboard navigation Alt text
Screen-reader support Tab order
High contrast colors Titles and labels
Focus mode Markers
Show data table (Alt plus Shift plus F11) Themes and contrast
Feature What to do
Alt text Format visual, General, Alt text; up to 250 characters; describe what the visual shows
Tab order Selection pane, Tab order; remove decorative items
Titles and labels Give every visual and page a clear title
Markers Turn on Show Markers and use different shapes for each series
Contrast Text and background at least 4.5 to 1 (WCAG 2.1)
Themes Use an accessible theme, color-blind friendly or high contrast

Do not use color alone to carry meaning. Report tooltips are not read by screen readers.

Exam tip

. Alt text holds up to 250 characters, and contrast must be at least 4.5 to 1. Remove decorative items from the tab order and use markers so that series differ by more than color.

5Automatic page refresh

Automatic page refresh updates the visuals on a page at a set time or when data changes. It works for DirectQuery, not Import. It is not the scheduled refresh of an Import model (Module 14).

Item Exact value
Supported sources DirectQuery; a composite model follows its most restrictive source; some live connections
Not supported Import models
Page refresh card Shown in the Format pane for reports that use DirectQuery
Types Fixed interval or change detection; each page uses one
Fixed interval default 30 minutes in Desktop
Fixed interval minimum 1 second in Desktop; 30 minutes on shared capacity; 5 minutes by default on Premium or Fabric
Change detection Polls one measure per model; refreshes only when its value changes
Change detection availability Premium or Fabric capacity workspaces only, never shared capacity
Change detection minimum 5 seconds by default

The capacity admin sets the minimum intervals and can turn the feature off.

Exam tip

. Import is not supported; change detection needs a Premium or Fabric capacity workspace. Fixed interval on shared capacity cannot go below 30 minutes.

Exam tip

. Change detection polls one measure per model and refreshes the page only when that value changes. Fixed interval refreshes on every tick of the timer.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A report must let viewers export only what each visual shows and never the rows underneath. Which report setting should the author choose?

  • AExport of summarized and underlying data together
  • BExport of summarized data only, no row detail
  • CExport for viewers that have the Build permission
  • DNo export of any data from the report, for anyone
Show the answer

Answer: B. The summarized data option exports the visual's data only, while the underlying option also exposes the rows behind it.

S2An author turns on the report setting that allows export of summarized and underlying data, yet viewers cannot export anything from the service. What is the most likely cause?

  • AThe report uses a theme that blocks data export
  • BPersonalize visuals is turned off for the report
  • CAn admin portal tenant setting restricts export
  • DThe mobile layout was not published with the report
Show the answer

Answer: C. Admin portal settings override the report-level export setting.

S3A report looks right on a desktop screen, and the author wants a portrait layout for phones. Where is it created, and where does it appear?

  • AIn Page view on the View tab; in any phone browser
  • BIn Mobile layout on the View tab; in any phone browser
  • CIn Page size on the Format pane; in the Power BI mobile apps
  • DIn Mobile layout on the View tab; in Power BI mobile apps
Show the answer

Answer: D. The mobile layout is created from the View tab and is used only in the Power BI mobile apps.

S4An author wants viewers to turn a column chart into a line chart and save their own version, without editing the report. What should the author turn on?

  • AAllow data export in the report settings
  • BA perspective created on the semantic model
  • CPersonalize visuals in the report settings
  • DContributor access for every report viewer
Show the answer

Answer: C. Personalize visuals lets viewers change the visual type and save the result as a personal bookmark.

S5A screen reader user cannot tell what a chart shows, and a keyboard user must tab through decorative images before reaching the charts. Which actions fix both problems?

  • AApply a high contrast theme and turn on Show data table
  • BAdd chart alt text and remove images from the tab order
  • CAdd data labels to the chart and turn on markers for lines
  • DAdd a title to each page and set Page view to Actual size
Show the answer

Answer: B. Alt text describes the chart to a screen reader, and removing decorative items from the tab order lets keyboard users skip them.

S6A DirectQuery report in a workspace on shared capacity must refresh a page only when new orders arrive. Why can the author not use change detection?

  • AChange detection does not support DirectQuery reports
  • BChange detection allows only one visual on the page
  • CChange detection needs scheduled refresh on the model
  • DChange detection needs a Premium or Fabric workspace
Show the answer

Answer: D. Change detection works only in workspaces on a Premium or Fabric capacity, not on shared capacity.

6.2 Recall questions

R1What are the three report-level export options?

Show the answer

Summarized data, summarized and underlying data, or no export.

R2What is the CSV export row limit?

Show the answer

30,000 rows.

R3Where does a mobile layout appear?

Show the answer

Only in the Power BI mobile apps.

R4How many characters can alt text hold?

Show the answer

Up to 250 characters.

R5What is the minimum contrast ratio for text?

Show the answer

4.5 to 1.

R6Which storage mode does automatic page refresh not support?

Show the answer

Import.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Export options Summarized data, summarized and underlying data, or none; admin portal overrides
Export limits CSV 30,000 rows; Excel 150,000; Excel from a live connection 500,000; underlying data needs Build; row-level security limits rows
Mobile layout View tab, Mobile layout; portrait grid; Page visuals pane; auto-create; only in the mobile apps
Personalization Personalize visuals report setting; change type, measure, legend, aggregation; personal bookmarks; perspectives are not security
Accessibility Alt text 250 characters; tab order; markers; contrast 4.5 to 1; accessible themes; tooltips not read
Automatic page refresh DirectQuery, not Import; fixed interval or change detection
Refresh minimums Fixed: 1 second Desktop, 30 minutes shared, 5 minutes default on capacity; change detection 5 seconds, Premium or Fabric only
